verdict.rationale: Figma documents plan access tokens that are scoped to an organization or enterprise plan. These tokens are user-agnostic, so requests are not made with a personal account, which suits agent or CI/CD credentials. The evidence does not show fine-grained permission scopes or least-privilege controls; it shows only plan-level scoping. Missing for 10: documented granular permission scopes (read-only vs write, per-resource), agent-specific credential issuance guidance, revocation/expiry controls, independent corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can issue scoped/least-privilege API credentials for an agent

citations.quote: A plan access token provides API access scoped to an organization or enterprise plan.
useful for needs like CI/CD implementations, logging, creating user-agnostic webhooks, and other tasks that you normally wouldn't want gated by a single individual
you can make requests on behalf of other users, and the requests themselves aren’t made using your personal Figma account.
